exercises.title: Distributed Cache Simulation
exercises.description: Simulate a distributed cache layer with node balancing and key distribution.
exercises.context: Distributed caches are used in scalable backend systems, CDNs, and high-performance APIs.
technicalNotes: Scalable systems rely on cache balancing.

exercises.title: Round Robin Load Balancer
exercises.description: Implement a simplified round-robin load balancing strategy.
exercises.context: Load balancers distribute traffic between servers in scalable infrastructures.

exercises.title: Realtime Chat Room Engine
exercises.description: Build the core logic behind a realtime multi-room chat system.
exercises.context: Realtime messaging systems power chats, collaboration platforms, and multiplayer systems.
technicalNotes: Chat systems organize users into rooms.
Realtime systems require efficient event handling.

exercises.title: Priority Background Job Queue
exercises.description: Design a scalable background processing queue with priorities.
exercises.context: Job queues are critical in scalable backend architectures and distributed systems.

exercises.title: API Gateway Request Router
exercises.description: Simulate an API Gateway responsible for routing requests to services.
exercises.context: API gateways centralize authentication, routing, and monitoring in microservice architectures.
technicalNotes: Microservice architectures rely heavily on gateways.

exercises.title: Microservice Event Bus
exercises.description: Implement a lightweight event bus for communication between services.
exercises.context: Event buses are used in microservices, realtime architectures, and scalable distributed systems.

exercises.title: Distributed Session Store
exercises.description: Create a scalable session storage layer for authenticated users.
exercises.context: Session stores are fundamental in authentication systems and scalable web applications.
technicalNotes: Distributed systems require shared session access.
Security systems depend on session management.

exercises.title: Inverted Search Index
exercises.description: Build a simplified inverted index for fast keyword searching.
exercises.context: Search engines and document systems use inverted indexes for fast lookups.
technicalNotes: Inverted indexes map words to documents.

exercises.title: Reliable Message Broker
exercises.description: Implement a basic reliable message broker with acknowledgements.
exercises.context: Message brokers coordinate communication between distributed services.

exercises.title: Service Discovery Registry
exercises.description: Create a registry where services can register and be discovered dynamically.
exercises.context: Service discovery is a core concept in cloud-native and microservice infrastructures.
technicalNotes: Cloud infrastructures depend on discovery mechanisms.

exercises.title: Circuit Breaker Pattern
exercises.description: Protect services from cascading failures using a circuit breaker mechanism.
exercises.context: Circuit breakers are essential in resilient distributed systems and microservice architectures.
technicalNotes: Circuit breakers prevent repeated failing requests.

exercises.title: Token Bucket Rate Limiter
exercises.description: Implement a token bucket algorithm for API request limiting.
exercises.context: Token bucket algorithms are widely used in APIs, gateways, and cloud infrastructures.
technicalNotes: APIs use these algorithms for stability.

exercises.title: Distributed Lock Manager
exercises.description: Simulate a distributed locking system for shared resources.
exercises.context: Distributed locks prevent race conditions in scalable backend systems.
technicalNotes: Race conditions can corrupt shared state.

exercises.title: Realtime Stream Processor
exercises.description: Process realtime event streams with filtering and transformations.
exercises.context: Stream processors power analytics pipelines, monitoring systems, and realtime platforms.
technicalNotes: Realtime analytics depend on stream pipelines.

exercises.title: Authentication Provider Simulator
exercises.description: Create a simplified authentication provider with token validation.
exercises.context: Authentication providers are core components in modern SaaS platforms and APIs.
technicalNotes: Modern APIs rely heavily on token systems.
